entities.summary: Arnold Schulman was an American playwright, screenwriter, producer, songwriter and novelist. He was a stage actor long associated with the American Theatre Wing and the Actors Studio. Arnold Schulman was a poets & playwrights from Philadelphia (1925-08-11, Philadelphia–2023-02-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
